scripts.dev:cn: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "cross-env DISABLED_EXCHANGES=bybit pnpm --filter @taofff/backend dev" "pnpm --filter @taofff/frontend dev"
scripts.dev:reset: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$ports=@(8080,5173); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($c in $conns){ Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; exit 0' ; pnpm dev:cn
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @taofff/shared build && pnpm --filter @taofff/backend build && pnpm --filter @taofff/frontend build
